findings.summary: The grid-growth test (commit bc2b036) was added after GREEN and never run RED, so the TDD step's RED-before-implementation rule was not followed for this case. Rebuttal item 4 concedes this. The test is non-vacuous: against the pre-fix code, the 6-row setValues on a 3-row grid would throw.
findings.suggestion: Record the deviation in index.json tdd_evidence, or run the new case against the pre-fix cropster.gs to capture a RED log. No code change is required for approval.

findings.summary: roastingUpsert_ silently drops any stored row whose week_start cell is blank, even when its profile and kg cells are populated. A human edit that clears a week_start would lose that row on the next post, with no refusal or log.
findings.suggestion: Log or count the skipped non-blank rows, or refuse the write when a row has non-blank data but a blank week_start. The spec does not mandate either, so this is a hardening choice.
